title: Metal Album of the Week: 12/16
contentHtml:
Strangers Only - My Ticket Home 
My Ticket Home is a Puke Rock band from Columbus, OH with a vibe that feels a lot like Nirvana and Beartooth had a child. "Strangers Only" is one of the only albums of the past 5 years that I can listen to on a daily basis and never get tired of.  
"Strangers Only" is available on iTunes for purchase today and you can stream it on Spotify as well.
